author: reek
body: The CDX emit path prunes every top-level definition not reachable from the root set. A direct call is the easy case. These are the shapes where the name at the site that needs the definition is not a call, and each is a way the prune could drop something the program still runs:

author: reek
body: A prune that drops any of them either fails the build with CDX2040 -- every call, address-of and effect-op slot is checked at finalize -- or changes an answer below. Every value is printed, so a green run with the wrong numbers is not available.
